import pandas as pd

trips = tables['trips']

# Calculate average share: yt / (anglers + 1) 
# (1 angler + fleet competitors conceptually; using anglers as proxy)
trips['avg_share'] = trips['yt'] / trips['anglers']

# Analyze the missed peaks
june_peak = trips[(trips['fish_date_season'] == 6) & (trips['fish_date_doy'].between(130, 152))]
sept_oct_peak = trips[(trips['fish_date_season'] == 6) & (trips['fish_date_doy'].between(175, 213))]

print("=== JUNE PEAK (d130-d152) ===")
june_summary = june_peak.groupby('cls').agg({
    'avg_share': 'mean',
    'yt': ['sum', 'count'],
    'anglers': 'mean'
}).round(2)
print(june_summary)

print("\n=== SEPT-OCT PEAK (d175-d213) ===")
sept_summary = sept_oct_peak.groupby('cls').agg({
    'avg_share': 'mean',
    'yt': ['sum', 'count'],
    'anglers': 'mean'
}).round(2)
print(sept_summary)

# Summarize my capital situation at key checkpoints
print("\n=== KEY MISSED PEAKS ===")

# Show what the top classes averaged in my absence windows
for window_name, doy_range in [('June', (130, 152)), ('Late Aug', (175, 195)), ('Sept-Oct', (196, 213))]:
    window = trips[(trips['fish_date_season'] == 6) & (trips['fish_date_doy'].between(doy_range[0], doy_range[1]))]
    if len(window) > 0:
        best_class = window.groupby('cls')['avg_share'].mean().idxmax()
        best_avg = window[window['cls'] == best_class]['avg_share'].mean()
        trips_count = len(window[window['cls'] == best_class])
        print(f"{window_name} (d{doy_range[0]}-{doy_range[1]}): {best_class} avg {best_avg:.2f} yt/angler ({trips_count} trips)")
